hypothesis: A static equal-BTC long Bitnomial BTCUSD spot / short Bitnomial Bitcoin USD Centi perpetual position can earn positive net carry because positive perpetual funding paid to shorts survives same-exchange execution costs, basis movement, collateral requirements, and conservative execution stress. Using the same venue materially reduces the Coinbase retail-fee hurdle and cross-venue basis mismatch present in Trial 8.

perpetualShort.productName: Perpetual Bitcoin US Dollar Centi Future

portfolio.perpetualContractCountRule: floor(targetNotionalUsd / (entryPerpetualVwapUsd * 0.01 BTC)), with one contract allowed only if one-contract notional is <=25% of starting equity

executionModel.primary: Use full public Bitnomial book snapshot VWAP for the exact frozen quantity at entry and exit. Buy spot against asks, sell spot against bids, sell perpetual against bids, buy perpetual against asks. Insufficient displayed depth fails the execution gate; do not extrapolate depth.

fundingAccounting.shortFundingPnlRule: For every first-party funding interval with startBoundary < interval_end <= endBoundary, credit btcQuantity * mark_price * funding_rate to the short. Positive funding means longs pay shorts.

antiLeakage.failureRule: After Trial 9 is frozen and the first candidate observation is written, any change to instruments, direction, sizing, costs, book execution rule, collateral, funding accounting, timing, data substitution, or stress rules requires a new trial number.
